python3 -c "
import statistics

# Monthly net outlays for FY1981 (in millions of dollars)
# From the table FFO-5 in Treasury Bulletin December 1981
monthly_outlays = [48049, 56202, 59099, 53969, 54216, 57198, 54608, 55619, 58486, 53095, 53698, 64216]

# Calculate population standard deviation
pstdev = statistics.pstdev(monthly_outlays)

print('Monthly net outlays for FY1981 (millions of dollars):')
months = ['Oct 1980', 'Nov 1980', 'Dec 1980', 'Jan 1981', 'Feb 1981', 'Mar 1981', 
          'Apr 1981', 'May 1981', 'Jun 1981', 'Jul 1981', 'Aug 1981', 'Sep 1981']
for m, v in zip(months, monthly_outlays):
    print(f'  {m}: {v:,}')

print(f'\\nPopulation standard deviation: {pstdev}')
print(f'Rounded to nearest hundredths: {round(pstdev, 2)}')
"
